title: OS-Genesis: Automating GUI Agent Trajectory Construction via Reverse Task Synthesis
authors_zh: Qiushi Sun、Kanzhi Cheng、Zichen Ding、Chuanyang Jin、Yian Wang、Fangzhi Xu、Zhenyu Wu、Chengyou Jia、Liheng Chen、Zhoumianze Liu、Ben Kao、Guohao Li、Junxian He、Yu Qiao、Zhiyong Wu
paper_type_zh: GUI 智能体轨迹构造方法与数据发布
best_for_zh: 研究环境交互轨迹、反向任务合成、轨迹奖励与 GUI 智能体训练的读者
one_line: OS-Genesis explores virtual GUIs first, reverse-synthesizes executable tasks from state-action-state triples, and uses graded trajectory rewards to sample mobile and web agent trajectories for SFT.
OS-Genesis 先探索虚拟 GUI，再从状态—动作—状态三元组反向合成可执行任务，并用分级轨迹奖励采样移动端与网页智能体轨迹用于 SFT。
why: It reverses instruction-first collection and preserves incomplete but potentially useful interaction evidence through reward-weighted sampling instead of binary filtering.
inclusion_reason: Directly relevant Track 6 environment or trajectory-feedback surface with executable GUI interactions, full-episode trajectories, a graded feedback contract, and released training rows.

title: Problem
问题
html:
GUI-agent data must align an abstract goal with a sequence of observations, intermediate intentions, and executable actions in a changing interface. Instruction-first collection is expensive when humans author and demonstrate full episodes; model-driven variants can propose tasks that are impossible in the current state, cover only familiar functions, or drift from the goal during execution.

OS-Genesis treats the environment as the source of task evidence. Its target object is a multimodal GUI episode containing a high-level instruction, step-level low-level instructions, actions, and states represented by screenshots and accessibility trees. Mobile and web experiments use virtualized environments, including AndroidWorld-style Android apps and WebArena websites. The public mobile Hugging Face release is a derived SFT surface rather than a one-row-per-episode archive: it currently exposes one train split with about 51.1K rows and fields id, image, and two-turn conversations.

This distinction matters for audit. The paper's main controlled comparison samples 1,000 trajectories, while the repository publishes separate mobile, web, and benchmark-specific training links plus raw state-action-state triples. Row counts, episodes, and experimental trajectories are therefore different units and should not be conflated.

GUI 智能体数据需要把抽象目标、连续观察、中间意图和可执行动作对齐到不断变化的界面中。以指令为起点的采集若依赖人工编写并演示完整回合，成本很高；由模型提出任务时，又可能生成当前状态下不可执行的目标、只覆盖熟悉功能，或在执行中偏离原目标。

OS-Genesis 把环境本身作为任务证据来源。其目标数据对象是多模态 GUI 回合，包括高层指令、逐步低层指令、动作，以及由截图和无障碍树表示的状态。移动端和网页实验均在虚拟化环境中进行，涉及 AndroidWorld 风格的 Android 应用和 WebArena 网站。公开的移动端 Hugging Face 数据是派生后的 SFT 训练面，而非一条记录对应一个完整回合的档案：当前仅有一个 train 划分，约 51.1K 行，字段为 id、image 和两轮 conversations。

审计时必须区分这些单位。论文主实验受控比较采样 1,000 条轨迹；代码仓库还分别链接移动端、网页端、特定基准训练数据及原始状态—动作—状态三元组。因此，发布行数、完整回合数和实验所用轨迹数不能等同。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central reversal is: discover an executable interaction first, then name the task it supports. Rule-based exploration traverses interactive GUI elements and records a pre-state/action/post-state triple. The discovery action set is CLICK, TYPE, and SCROLL; GPT-4o supplies content for text-entry fields, while the remaining exploration policy is described as rule based.

GPT-4o reads the action and before/after visual evidence to write a concise low-level instruction, an analysis of possible continuation, and an executable high-level task. Those high-level tasks are then executed in the environment by a GUI-capable model such as GPT-4o, yielding full trajectories. This ordering grounds task wording in an observed state transition instead of asking a generator to imagine a task from the initial screen alone.

The second idea is to avoid a binary complete/fail discard. A Trajectory Reward Model (TRM) assigns each trajectory a score from 1 to 5 for completion and coherence. Sampling uses P(g_i)=R_i/sum_k R_k, so incomplete trajectories remain eligible but are down-weighted. This is a sampling contract, not proof that every retained step is correct.

核心反转是：先发现可执行交互，再为它命名能够支持的任务。规则驱动的探索遍历可交互 GUI 元素并记录“动作前状态—动作—动作后状态”三元组。发现阶段的动作集合为 CLICK、TYPE 和 SCROLL；文本输入内容由 GPT-4o 生成，其余探索策略被论文描述为规则驱动。

GPT-4o 根据动作及其前后视觉证据，生成简洁的低层指令、后续操作分析和可执行的高层任务。随后由 GPT-4o 这类具备 GUI 操作能力的模型在环境中执行高层任务，得到完整轨迹。该顺序让任务表述扎根于已经发生的状态变化，而不是只看初始界面凭空设想任务。

第二个关键点是不以二元“完成/失败”直接丢弃数据。轨迹奖励模型（TRM）按完成度和连贯性给每条轨迹 1–5 分，并按 P(g_i)=R_i/sum_k R_k 采样。因此，不完整轨迹仍可进入训练，但权重较低。这是一项采样契约，并不证明所有保留步骤都正确。

title: Method
方法
html:
Construction has four auditable stages. First, a virtual Android emulator or web environment is explored, and each valid interaction records pre-state, action, and post-state screenshots. The paper also uses accessibility trees; for training they are filtered to retain visible elements' position or index information. Second, GPT-4o reverse-synthesizes a low-level instruction and then a high-level, task- or question-oriented instruction from each observed transition.

Third, synthesized tasks seed model execution in the environment. Full episodes contain the high-level goal, low-level intentions, action history, GUI actions, screenshots, and accessibility observations. The paper says the synthesis pipeline requires no human intervention, although later TRM validation uses human annotations. The public repository separately offers construction scripts, raw mobile/web triples with screenshots and JSON, derived training data, evaluation code, and checkpoints.

Fourth, GPT-4o serves as TRM. It receives the high-level instruction, the full low-level-instruction history, and screenshots from the final three timesteps, then scores completion and coherence from 1 to 5. Reward-proportional sampling feeds two SFT objectives: planning predicts a low-level instruction and action from state, high-level goal, and history; action training predicts the action from state, history, and low-level instruction. Reported backbones are InternVL2-4B, InternVL2-8B, and Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct, fully fine-tuned on eight A100 80GB GPUs. Exact optimizer, schedule, epochs, temperature, rollout budget, and seed are undisclosed.

Reset and replay are under-specified. Evaluation uses AndroidWorld system-state checks and WebArena functional evaluators, but the paper does not provide a pinned app/site snapshot, deterministic reset recipe, or guarantee that released episodes can be replayed against the original environment state.

构造流程可分为四个可审计阶段。第一，在虚拟 Android 模拟器或网页环境中探索；每次有效交互都记录动作前状态、动作和动作后状态截图。论文也使用无障碍树，训练时仅保留屏幕可见元素的位置或索引信息。第二，GPT-4o 从已观察到的状态变化反向合成低层指令，再生成任务型或问答型高层指令。

第三，合成任务作为模型在环境中执行的起点。完整回合包含高层目标、低层意图、动作历史、GUI 动作、截图和无障碍观察。论文称合成流水线无需人工介入，但后续 TRM 有效性分析使用了人工评分。公开仓库分别提供构造脚本、带截图和 JSON 的移动端/网页端原始三元组、派生训练数据、评测代码和模型权重。

第四，GPT-4o 充当 TRM。其输入包括高层指令、完整低层指令历史和最后三个时间步的截图，并按完成度与连贯性给出 1–5 分。按奖励比例采样后执行两种 SFT 目标：规划训练根据状态、高层目标和历史预测低层指令及动作；动作训练根据状态、历史和低层指令预测动作。报告的骨干模型为 InternVL2-4B、InternVL2-8B 和 Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct，使用 8 张 A100 80GB GPU 全参数微调。优化器、学习率计划、轮数、温度、rollout 预算和随机种子未披露。

环境重置与重放说明不足。评测分别依赖 AndroidWorld 的系统状态检查和 WebArena 的功能正确性评估器，但论文没有给出固定的应用/网站快照、确定性重置配方，也未保证公开回合可在原环境状态上重放。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
In the main controlled setting, OS-Genesis and the task-driven baseline each use 1,000 trajectories; self-instruction uses 1,500, and average trajectory length is 6.4 steps. On AndroidWorld, Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct improves from 9.82% success with the self-instruction baseline to 17.41% with OS-Genesis. InternVL2-4B reaches 15.18% and InternVL2-8B reaches 16.96% under OS-Genesis. On WebArena, overall success is 7.88%, 9.96%, and 10.79% for those three backbones, respectively.

The TRM evidence is more directly relevant to the feedback contract. On 200 sampled web and mobile trajectories, GPT-4o scores correlate with Qwen2.5-VL-72B scores at Spearman 0.788 for web and 0.729 for mobile. On 100 sampled trajectories, GPT-4o TRM scores correlate with human scores at 0.798 for web and 0.813 for mobile. An ablation compares equal sampling, binary labeler filtering, and TRM sampling; the paper reports stronger high-level-task performance for TRM, while binary filtering can slightly favor high-level success but reduce low-level results.

These results support the usefulness of the pipeline and graded sampler under the reported setup. They do not establish that the released data are error-free, that gains transfer to other environment versions, or that benchmark overlap has been excluded. The public mobile dataset page independently confirms approximately 51.1K SFT rows in one train split, MIT metadata, and id/image/conversations fields.

主实验的受控设置中，OS-Genesis 与任务驱动基线各使用 1,000 条轨迹，自指令基线使用 1,500 条，平均轨迹长度为 6.4 步。在 AndroidWorld 上，Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct 从自指令基线的 9.82% 成功率提升至 OS-Genesis 的 17.41%；InternVL2-4B 和 InternVL2-8B 在 OS-Genesis 下分别达到 15.18% 和 16.96%。在 WebArena 上，三种骨干模型的总体成功率依次为 7.88%、9.96% 和 10.79%。

与反馈契约更直接相关的是 TRM 证据。对抽样的 200 条网页端和移动端轨迹，GPT-4o 与 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 评分的 Spearman 相关系数分别为 0.788 和 0.729。对抽样的 100 条轨迹，GPT-4o TRM 与人工评分的相关系数分别为网页端 0.798、移动端 0.813。消融实验比较等概率采样、二元标签器过滤和 TRM 采样；论文报告 TRM 对高层任务更有效，而二元过滤虽可能略微提高高层成功表现，却会降低低层结果。

这些结果支持该流水线和分级采样器在论文设置中的实用性，但不能证明发布数据无误、结果可迁移到其他环境版本，或已经排除基准重合。公开移动端数据页独立确认了约 51.1K 行 SFT 数据、单一训练划分、MIT 元数据，以及 id、image、conversations 字段。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The novelty is not simply using an LLM to write GUI instructions. OS-Genesis changes the causal order of collection: an interaction that the current environment demonstrably supports is discovered first, and language tasks are synthesized afterward. This reduces the mismatch between imagined tasks and dynamic GUI state and can expose functions overlooked by initial-screen task proposal.

Its second contribution is a graded utilization policy for failure. Prior binary labelers typically retain complete trajectories and discard incomplete ones. OS-Genesis treats partial episodes as potentially useful exploration evidence, scores completion and coherence on five levels, and uses the score as a sampling weight. The approach therefore couples environment-grounded task invention, model execution, and feedback-weighted SFT in one construction recipe.

The method should not be read as a new deterministic verifier. TRM is an LLM judge with measured correlations, not an executable proof of task completion. Environment-native success predicates appear in downstream benchmarks, while construction-time supervision remains model based.

其新意不只是让大模型编写 GUI 指令，而是改变数据采集的因果顺序：先发现当前环境确实支持的交互，再生成语言任务。这能减少凭空设想任务与动态 GUI 状态之间的不匹配，也更可能发现只看初始界面时容易遗漏的功能。

第二项贡献是对失败轨迹采用分级利用策略。传统二元标签器通常保留完整轨迹、丢弃不完整轨迹；OS-Genesis 把部分回合视为可能有用的探索证据，按完成度与连贯性分为五档，再把分数用作采样权重。因此，该方法把环境扎根的任务发现、模型执行和反馈加权 SFT 串成一套构造配方。

该方法不能被理解为新的确定性验证器。TRM 是经过相关性测量的 LLM judge，而非任务完成的可执行证明。环境原生成功谓词用于下游基准评测，构造阶段监督仍然依赖模型判断。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The largest dependency is GPT-4o: it supplies text-entry content, reverse-synthesizes instructions, executes tasks, and scores trajectories. The paper tests score alignment with Qwen2.5-VL-72B and humans, but correlated judges can share blind spots. The authors also state that task-executing model capability limits how many trajectories can be constructed successfully.

Incomplete episodes are deliberately retained through nonzero reward. This preserves useful prefixes but may teach dead ends, redundant actions, or incorrect partial plans. The TRM sees low-level instructions and only the last three states, so long-range omissions or side effects outside that window may be missed. Score calibration across apps, websites, and environment revisions is not established.

Release auditability remains partial. The mobile Hugging Face data has one train split and no documented task-, app-, or template-disjoint split. Decontamination against AndroidControl, AndroidWorld, WebArena, pretrained-model data, or generated task templates is unknown. Exact environment/app versions, reset state, credentials, network conditions, and deterministic replay protocol are not pinned. The paper gives no privacy review, PII-removal procedure, or security policy for model-generated interaction content.

The Hugging Face card declares MIT, but separate rights for screenshots, app assets, websites, model outputs, and Google Drive raw triples are not documented. The GitHub repository shows no formal release objects, so reproducible use should pin repository and dataset revisions independently.

最大依赖是 GPT-4o：它生成文本输入内容、反向合成指令、执行任务并为轨迹评分。论文检验了其与 Qwen2.5-VL-72B 和人工评分的一致性，但相关的评判者仍可能共享盲点。作者也明确指出，任务执行模型的能力限制了成功构造轨迹的数量。

不完整回合会因非零奖励而被刻意保留。这能保存有用前缀，也可能让模型学习死路、冗余动作或错误的部分计划。TRM 看到低层指令和最后三个状态，因此可能漏掉更早发生的错误或窗口之外的副作用；其跨应用、网站和环境版本的分数校准也未被证明。

发布审计仍不完整。移动端 Hugging Face 数据只有一个训练划分，没有按任务、应用或模板隔离的划分说明。与 AndroidControl、AndroidWorld、WebArena、预训练数据或生成任务模板之间的去污染情况未知。环境和应用版本、重置状态、凭据、网络条件及确定性重放协议均未固定。论文也未披露隐私检查、个人信息移除流程或模型生成交互内容的安全策略。

Hugging Face 卡片声明 MIT，但截图、应用资产、网站、模型输出及 Google Drive 原始三元组的独立权利基础没有说明。GitHub 仓库没有正式 release 对象，因此复现使用时应分别固定代码与数据修订版本。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the environment_agent_trajectory_data track, OS-Genesis is a compact example of how environment interaction becomes post-training supervision. It exposes the chain from state transition, to task language, to rollout, to graded feedback, to SFT sampling. The raw triples are useful for studying task synthesis independently of execution; full trajectories support planning/action training; derived mobile rows illustrate how an episode is flattened into multimodal conversations.

The Card is especially useful when comparing feedback contracts. Environment success checks in AndroidWorld and WebArena are terminal evaluators, whereas construction-time TRM is a probabilistic judge over completion and coherence. Keeping both layers separate helps prevent benchmark success from being mistaken for intrinsic data correctness.

Practical uses include reproducing reverse task synthesis, training GUI agents with planning and action objectives, analyzing how failed rollouts are weighted, and auditing screenshot/accessibility-tree supervision. Before combining the release with other trajectory corpora, users should reconstruct episode boundaries, identify duplicated screenshots or paired objectives, pin revisions, establish app/task splits, and review rights, privacy, and unsafe-action exposure.

对 environment_agent_trajectory_data 赛道而言，OS-Genesis 是“环境交互如何转化为后训练监督”的紧凑案例。它展示了从状态变化、任务语言、环境 rollout、分级反馈到 SFT 采样的完整链路。原始三元组可用于独立研究任务合成，完整轨迹支持规划与动作训练，派生移动端行则展示如何把回合展开为多模态对话样本。

该卡片特别适合比较反馈契约。AndroidWorld 和 WebArena 的环境成功检查是终止评估器，构造阶段的 TRM 则是对完成度与连贯性做概率性判断的 judge。区分这两层，可以避免把基准成功率误当成数据本身正确性的证明。

实际用途包括复现反向任务合成、用规划与动作目标训练 GUI 智能体、分析失败 rollout 的权重，以及审计截图与无障碍树监督。将该发布与其他轨迹语料合并前，应重建回合边界，识别重复截图或成对训练目标，固定修订版本，建立应用/任务划分，并检查权利、隐私和危险动作暴露。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Section 3 for interaction-driven discovery, reverse task synthesis, and reward-proportional trajectory sampling; Section 4 defines the two SFT objectives and controlled 1K-trajectory comparisons; Section 5 and Appendix F provide the strongest evidence about diversity, scaling, failure retention, and TRM alignment.
  • Keep the object boundary explicit: exploration triples, complete trajectories, and 51.1K released SFT rows are different objects. A TRM score is soft feedback, not an environment-verifiable terminal label, and retaining an incomplete episode does not certify it as successful.
  • Treat benchmark improvements as evidence about trained agents in specific environments, not as validation of release licensing, privacy, split hygiene, or replayability.
  • For reproduction, pin code and dataset revisions, map each SFT row back to an episode and objective, preserve screenshot-to-observation linkage, and document reset. Rollout count, score distribution, optimizer, seed, construction split, decontamination, replay success, and upstream GUI rights remain unknown.

• 第 3 节定义交互驱动发现、反向任务合成和奖励比例轨迹采样；第 4 节定义两种 SFT 目标和 1,000 条轨迹的受控比较；第 5 节及附录 F 给出多样性、规模效应、失败轨迹保留和 TRM 一致性的主要证据。
  • 始终区分探索三元组、完整轨迹与公开的 51.1K 行 SFT 数据。TRM 分数是软反馈，不是环境可验证的终止标签；保留不完整回合也不等于认证其成功。
  • 把基准提升视为特定环境中训练后智能体的证据，而不是发布许可、隐私、划分卫生或可重放性的验证。
  • 复现时应固定代码与数据修订，把 SFT 行映射回回合和目标，保留截图—观察对应关系并记录重置。rollout 总数、分数分布、优化器、种子、构造划分、去污染、重放成功率及上游 GUI 权利仍为未知。
